name: Backyard Sandbox
description: A framed, in-ground sandbox with a bench-style lid to keep debris and pets out overnight. Good first project for parents building with young kids underfoot.

name: Kids' Picnic Table
description: A scaled-down picnic table sized for kids 4-10, seating up to four. Reuses the same joinery as the adult version, so it's a good starter build.

name: A-Frame Swing Set (single swing)
description: A classic A-frame with one swing seat, rated for up to 150 lbs. Needs the widest clearance in this set because of the swing's arc.

name: Simple Playhouse
description: A basic four-wall, pitched-roof playhouse with a door and one window cutout, no flooring included. The biggest build here, and a good early test case for the safety/complication rules once they're live.
_note: materials is a worked example (matches the sample BOM in docs/budget-materials.md) so the schema has at least one fully-populated project; the other 7 still need materials authored.

name: Raised Garden Bed (4x8)
description: A single 4x8 raised bed, about 12 in. deep, for anyone starting a vegetable or flower garden. The fastest build in the whole seed list.
_note: obstacles_relevant taken directly from the example given in docs/basic-safety-complication-flagging-rules.md ('a raised bed cares about slope and utility lines'); still worth Austin confirming.

name: Firewood Storage Rack
description: An open-sided rack that keeps a cord of firewood off the ground and covered on top. Solves the classic firewood-rotting-in-a-pile problem.

name: Compost Bin (3-bay)
description: A three-bin compost system so users can rotate active, curing, and finished compost separately. A step up in complexity, but still no power tools beyond a drill.

name: Trash & Recycling Bin Corral
description: A slatted enclosure with a hinged gate that hides trash and recycling bins from the street. The gate swing is why it needs more clearance than the garden bed or firewood rack.
_note: obstacles_relevant is a draft guess (gate swing suggests proximity to a fence line) - needs Austin's confirmation, not asserted as final.
